name: Auto-Connect Toggle for Peer Mesh
description: Replace per-peer connect/disconnect buttons with a single toggle button that manages the entire peer mesh. When started, the system discovers and connects to all peers on the local network. When stopped, it disconnects from all peers and halts discovery/listening.

userStories.title: Start Toggle Button
userStories.description: As a user I want a single "Start" button in the GUI So that I can begin discovering and connecting to all peers on my local network with one click
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: A toggle button labeled "Start" is visible when the engine is stopped
AC2: Clicking "Start" initiates local network discovery (mDNS broadcast)
AC3: Each discovered peer receives one connection attempt per discovery cycle
AC4: Button label changes to "Stop" after successful start
AC5: Status indicator reflects "Running" state after start
AC6: Existing per-peer Connect/Disconnect buttons are removed or hidden

userStories.title: Stop Toggle Button
userStories.description: As a user I want a single "Stop" button when the system is running So that I can disconnect from all peers and halt discovery with one click
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When running, toggle button displays "Stop" label
AC2: Clicking "Stop" disconnects all currently connected peers
AC3: Discovery/listening services are stopped
AC4: Button label changes to "Start" after successful stop
AC5: Status indicator reflects "Stopped" state after stop
AC6: All peer connection state is cleared

userStories.title: Auto-Connect to Discovered Peers
userStories.description: As a started peer I want to automatically connect to other started peers on the same LAN So that the mesh forms without manual intervention
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: On each discovery cycle, newly discovered peers are connected to automatically
AC2: Connection attempts are made once per discovery cycle (no persistent retry)
AC3: Failed connections are retried on the next discovery cycle, not immediately
AC4: Peer list UI shows connection status for all discovered peers
AC5: Local peer appears in peer list with "(Local)" designation

userStories.title: Peer Status Display
userStories.description: As a user I want to see which peers are discovered and their connection status So that I can verify the mesh is forming correctly
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Peer list shows all discovered peers with hostname and IP address
AC2: Each peer shows current connection state (connected/connecting/disconnected)
AC3: Peer list updates as peers are discovered or disappear
AC4: Last-seen timestamp is displayed for each peer
AC5: Platform type (macOS/Windows/Linux) is shown when available
